One generic product. All nine layouts.

The same field set — filled once by a single fictional product, the Aurora Wireless Headphones — rendered through every layout in the Amazon Product Showcase plugin. Nothing here is product-specific: swap in a book, a lamp, or a shampoo and each template fills from whatever fields that product has, hiding the rest. Pick any real product later and compare it against this neutral reference.

About this product

Meet the Aurora Wireless Headphones — built for long days, long flights, and everything in between. Adaptive noise cancellation quiets the world around you, while custom 40mm drivers keep music warm, clear, and detailed. Plush memory-foam earcups and a 40-hour battery mean you can listen from morning commute to evening wind-down without a recharge. Pair two devices at once, switch with a tap, and fold them flat when you're on the move.

Picking a layout

Same product, same data — the layout only decides how the story is told. All nine combine with any of the three colour styles using the switcher at the top of this page.

Cardlayout="card"
Compact embeds in posts and roundups Full Pagelayout="full"
The classic detail page — safe default Showcaselayout="showcase"
Oversized hero with a closing CTA band Editorial Splitlayout="editorial"
Serif, drop cap, pull-quote, stat strip Centered Landinglayout="landing"
Centre stage, oversized price, pinned buy bar Sidebar Commercelayout="sidebar"
Sticky buy panel beside a scrolling story Split Herolayout="split"
Two-tone panel, full-height photo, trust strip Story Scrolllayout="story"
Numbered chapters and a testimonial banner Bento Gridlayout="bento"
Every field its own tile — one-screen scan

Reference mockups for the Amazon Product Showcase plugin (design system v1.6.0). The Aurora Wireless Headphones are a fictional sample product — the same placeholder the plugin itself uses — so every layout here can be judged as a pure template. On a live site, each buy button links to that product's Amazon page; fields a product doesn't have are hidden rather than filled. Product photo: clean studio shot sourced for this reference page.
